item.text: {"verdicts":[{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0009-R05-E001","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0009-R05-E002","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0009-R05-E003","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0009-R05-E004","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"Egypt's Constitution and criminal legislation describe equality before the law, prohibit discrimination on listed grounds, criminalize religious bullying, and provide imprisonment and fines for discriminatory acts or omissions, incitement to religious discrimination, and certain offenses committed by public officials.","notes":["Narrowed the wording to distinguish the separate provisions on discriminatory acts or omissions, incitement, and offenses committed by public officials."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0009-R05-E005","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]}]}
